parsed.why: No trans-specific statute, but a documented pattern of police harassment at identity checks, vagrancy/public-order arrests and violent detentions of trans people; no anti-discrimination recourse; conservative, stigmatising society. State targeting reaches travellers directly.

Gender nonconformity itself criminal under uncodified sharia with flogging, prison and possible death; documented arrests for cross-dressing, mass sentencing, a trans woman dead in custody, and a traveller arrested at the airport.

Unenforced sodomy statute is secondary; decisive are routine police extortion/detention of trans people, birth-sex cell placement and forced exams in custody. Strong contrary signal: courts actually granting trans relief and compensation.

Sodomy statute (one year) used occasionally, including against gender-nonconforming people; rising hostile legislative pressure; no transition care; concealment is the norm. No documented police-targeting pattern or protection, so thin-data extrapolation toward risk.

No sodomy law, no documented anti-trans violence, and prosecutorial guidance treating anti-trans hostility as aggravating. Offset by state policy targeting LGBTQ advocacy/promotion, marriage ban, no anti-discrimination law and a conservative society.
